contents.desc: While dumplings are famous, China’s baozi (steamed buns) are just as delicious and diverse! Here are 6 regional favorites:
1. Xinjiang Baked Baozi (Samsa)
Thin dough wrapped around spiced lamb, onions, and cumin—crispy outside, juicy inside.
2. Jiangsu Crab Roe Soup Bun
Invented centuries ago, these delicate buns are filled with crab meat and rich broth. The skin is so thin it almost melts!
3. Shanghai Pan-Fried Buns (Shengjianbao)
Crispy bottom, soft top, and filled with savory pork and hot, flavorful soup. A perfect bite!
4. Hangzhou Xiaolongbao
Thin, translucent wrappers hold generous filling and steaming broth—often enjoyed with a straw for the soup first!
5. Guangdong Char Siu Bao
A Cantonese dim sum classic! Fluffy buns stuffed with sweet-and-savory barbecued pork.
6. Shandong Steam-Fried Buns
Golden-crisp at the bottom, soft on top, with rich fillings. Masterfully cooked with water-based pan-frying for the perfect texture.
Which one would you try first? 🥢

contents.desc: Para sa mga nagbabalak, mag Binondo Food Trip, here's a list of food stops you might want to try!
